prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square beFood x KFC sports-night promotion poster set inside a blue football stadium with floodlights and a green field. Place the yellow beFood wordmark at the top center. Add large white text '17.7 Hè vị chill lên World Cup', then a yellow rounded block with red text 'Giảm 20%', and below it the white line 'Giảm tối đa 40k cho đơn từ 150k'. In the foreground, show a black bowl of rice and crispy chicken on the left, and a white KFC box full of fried chicken on the right with an extra sauced drumstick on a plate behind. Add a flying soccer ball with motion streaks on the right and a small cheering be mascot with pom-poms on the lower left. Technical style: photoreal food advertising poster with sports-stadium composite, stadium floodlight commercial lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
